notes.title: VirZOOM Gamepad Emulator Support Update
notes.content:
We're sorry to say that for the time being we cannot further support the VirZOOM Gamepad Emulator.  We will happily leave it here for anyone to download and use, and you can continue to reference the documentation we have for it at:

https://virzoom.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/help/pages/1835083/Gamepad+Emulator

We have a small team and need to focus on other priorities in this rapidly changing VR market.  If there is an opportunity to revisit the emulator in the future, we would love to do so.  We hope everyone understands why we had to make this decision.

notes.title: The VZ Gamepad Emulator: Submissions Welcome!
notes.content:
Welcome to the VirZOOM Gamepad Emulator! While we design our own exercise games for [b][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/448710/]VirZOOM Arcade[/url][/b] to be fun and endlessly replayable in their own right, we've always wanted to let you work out while playing your own favorite games, whatever they may be. To that end, we offer the [b][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/501280/]VirZOOM Gamepad Emulator[/url][/b], which allows you to play other VR and PC games using your VirZOOM bike in place of a traditional controller.

The VZ Gamepad Emulator is still a young product, but we're eager to build on it with your help. Before you can use your VirZOOM bike with another game, the emulator needs a special configuration file to define what different inputs mean – pedal to move forward, right trigger to switch gears, and so on. And those configuration files take time to get right! We've uploaded a few ourselves so far and have more in the pipeline, allowing you to play [b]Project Cars[/b], [b]Radial-G[/b], [b]Time Machine VR[/b], and [b]Eve: Valkyrie – [/b]with an alternate configuration featuring head-tracking on the way soon!

We're especially looking forward to seeing what kinds of configurations our community comes up with, both for VR games and 2D games on PC. Thinking you might want to give it a try? Drop by the [b][url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/501280/discussions/]VZGE Steam Forum[/url] [/b]to let folks know what you're working on. We encourage users to try out and review one another's configurations, and we're looking forward to sending out t-shirts for great contributions.
